tasks.short: Construct prosthetic or orthopedic appliances or supervise fabrication.

steps.what: Verify actual appliance specifications, patient measurements and fabrication requirements
inputs: actual checked patient measurements and chosen appliance design

steps.what: Locate current material specifications and relevant appliance fabrication instructions
inputs: actual controlled material and fabrication sources

steps.what: Construct actual appliances or supervise fabrication and perform actual process checks
outputs: actual fabricated appliance and process observations

steps.what: Write and check actual fabrication observations and retain the appliance production record
inputs: actual fabricated appliance and process observations
outputs: checked saved actual appliance fabrication record

tasks.design: Configure controlled material and fabrication-source links in the appliance-production {OPS_SYSTEM} and {DOCS}. Reduce repeated source navigation while retaining specification verification, actual fabrication/supervision and complete production records; ordinary internal saves earn no saving or self-gate.
tasks.previous_blocker: Current fabrication and material instructions can take repeated navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native specification-to-source links can remove some locating effort.
tasks.still_hard: Actual material behaviour, geometry and patient-specific constraints need skilled fabrication.
tasks.human_edge: The practitioner detects a fabrication defect that a completed record would not reveal.
tasks.altitude: Slightly less instruction navigation; fabrication responsibility stays unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: controlled fabrication-source links can reduce navigation while appliance construction and verification remain skilled physical work.

assumptions: Provisional shares include only focal hands-on or supervision time, not technicians' labour. Two of10 source points are repeated navigation; actual source reading and physical checks remain. Existing workshop automation and native links receive no new credit.

Prescriber supplies actual prescription; measurement/design producer supplies checked dimensions, side, units and design version. Material/document owners supply actual material id, revision and applicability. Missing or conflicting inputs are clarified manually. Actual observations/traceability are recorded after fabrication. No automatic clinical release or new patient observation is inferred.
unknowns: Are current instructions already linked to production jobs?
research_questions: Can source links preserve material and device revision distinctions?

incremental.description: Maintain applicable fabrication and material-source links.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes2 repeated instruction-navigation points minus0.3 upkeep=1.7. Low: an unusual appliance needs new fabrication research, leaving only0.5 known material-source locating points removed, minus0.3=0.2. Specification checks, actual fabrication and complete production records retain their time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Confer with physicians on device specifications and prescriptions.

steps.what: Review actual patient information, measurements and the physician's device question
inputs: actual patient record and checked measurements

steps.what: Prepare device-specification consultation sheet from actual checked patient facts
Confer with physicians to formulate actual orthopedic or prosthetic specifications and prescription requirements
inputs: actual physician assessment and patient circumstances
outputs: actual specification discussion and agreed clinical requirements

steps.what: Write and check actual consultation findings and retain the internal specification record
inputs: actual specification discussion and agreed clinical requirements
outputs: checked saved actual device consultation record

tasks.design: Configure reuse of actual patient identity and verified measurement fields in the consultation sheet within clinical {OPS_SYSTEM}/{DOCS}. Retain clinical interpretation, physician discussion and the full actual consultation record; the physician's own prescription decision and issue remain outside any focal saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Consultation sheets may repeat identity and measurement presentation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native field reuse can remove repeated presentation work without proposing a prescription.
tasks.still_hard: Device suitability and clinical requirements need practitioner and physician judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The practitioner identifies a practical fitting constraint that changes the specification discussion.
tasks.altitude: Less consultation-sheet preparation; clinical authority stays unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native reuse of verified clinical fields can assist consultation preparation while clinical specification discussions remain human.

assumptions: Provisional preparation20 includes four repeated identity/measurement presentation points removed; sixteen selection/context/check points remain. Existing field reuse gets no new credit. This boundary is focal consultation and its actual notes, not a new prescription approval or send.

Actual clinical/measurement producers supply patient id, date, side, dimensions/units, method and verification status through authorised record fields. Practitioner checks these in s1; absent or inconsistent data requires manual clarification or actual measurement. No free extraction or invented patient fact. Ordinary internal note saving stays within fully retained s4 without self-approval.
unknowns: Which fields are already reused in the actual clinical system?
research_questions: Can preparation preserve measurement side, date and units without extra correction work?

incremental.description: Maintain consultation field mappings and clinical access boundaries.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes4 repeated presentation points minus0.6 upkeep=3.4. Low: an atypical device requires mostly fresh measurement context, leaving only1 identity-field presentation point removed, minus0.6=0.4. Clinical review, actual physician discussion and complete written findings retain their time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Demonstrate and explain appliances to healthcare workers.

steps.what: Choose appropriate appliance examples and explanation for the healthcare workers' actual needs
inputs: actual appliances and current device instructions
outputs: chosen device explanation and demonstration scope

steps.what: Prepare selected appliance diagrams and written explanation sections
inputs: chosen device explanation and demonstration scope
actual current appliance diagrams and method sections

steps.what: Check complete explanation for the actual appliance and retain final internal material
outputs: checked saved final appliance explanation material

steps.what: Show actual orthopedic and prosthetic appliances and explain them to healthcare workers
inputs: checked saved final appliance explanation material
actual appliances and healthcare worker questions

steps.what: Write and check actual demonstration follow-up notes when assigned
outputs: checked saved actual demonstration follow-up notes

tasks.design: Configure reuse of selected current appliance diagrams and explanation sections in {DOCS}. Keep actual device-specific selection, complete final checking, physical demonstration, explanation and any assigned fresh follow-up record; internal saves are unchanged and ungated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Stable device diagrams and method sections can be assembled repeatedly.
tasks.enabler_now: Native section reuse can remove assembly without explaining a device for the practitioner.
tasks.still_hard: Workers' understanding and actual appliance handling need real demonstration.
tasks.human_edge: The practitioner recognises and corrects a dangerous misunderstanding during demonstration.
tasks.altitude: Less explanation-material assembly; teaching stays human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native reuse of controlled appliance illustrations can reduce preparation while live demonstration remains human.

assumptions: Provisional preparation20 includes five repeated illustration/section assembly points; fifteen adaptation points remain, plus full final checking10. Existing reuse earns no new credit. No separate material distribution is invented: explanation uses the material live.

Device/method owners supply actual model, instruction revision, diagram permission and applicability. Missing material is obtained manually. Practitioner supplies real questions and observations after demonstration; follow-up notes only if actually assigned, otherwise remove/reweight. No competence or patient outcome inferred from attendance.
unknowns: Which controlled appliance illustrations can be reused?
research_questions: Can material reuse preserve device-specific cautions and actual handling differences?

incremental.description: Maintain appliance illustrations and applicability revisions.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes5 repeated diagram/section assembly points minus0.5 upkeep=4.5. Low: a novel appliance needs new illustrations and explanation, leaving only1 unchanged handling-section point removed, minus0.5=0.5. Selection, full final checks, physical explanation and actual follow-up remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Train and supervise orthopedic and prosthetic support staff.

steps.what: Assess actual assistants' and technicians' training needs and choose supervision objectives
inputs: actual support-staff work and observed needs
outputs: chosen support-staff training and supervision objectives

steps.what: Prepare and check selected workshop training sections and actual practice instructions
inputs: chosen support-staff training and supervision objectives
outputs: checked saved final support-staff training materials

steps.what: Train and supervise actual assistants and technicians during real appliance work
inputs: checked saved final support-staff training materials
outputs: actual supervised work, observations and feedback

steps.what: Write and check actual supervision findings and assigned training-outcome records
inputs: actual supervised work, observations and feedback
outputs: checked saved actual support-staff training and supervision record

tasks.design: Configure reusable selected workshop method sections in {DOCS}/{LMS}. Retain actual staff assessment, device-specific adaptation, complete material checks, direct training/supervision and actual observed outcome records; ordinary internal saves earn no saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Stable workshop training sections can be assembled repeatedly.
tasks.enabler_now: Native controlled-section reuse can remove preparation effort.
tasks.still_hard: Safe technique and supervision require actual observation and feedback.
tasks.human_edge: The practitioner spots a handling habit that would produce an unreliable appliance.
tasks.altitude: Less training-material assembly; supervision and staff decisions stay unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: controlled method-section reuse can reduce staff-training preparation while hands-on supervision remains human.

assumptions: Provisional preparation20 includes four repeat section-assembly points; sixteen adaptation/check points remain. Actual staff work is not focal labour; only practitioner supervision60 is counted. No automatic staff assessment or existing-runtime saving.

Method owners supply actual revision, applicability and procedure sections; practitioner supplies actual objectives and post-practice observations. Missing content is developed manually. Outcome records only reflect actual observed work and actual assigned recording; no competence inference from course enrolment. Ordinary internal save is included unchanged without self-approval.
unknowns: Which actual workshop sections are stable and already reusable?
research_questions: Can reuse preserve distinctions between assistant and technician responsibilities?

incremental.description: Maintain current workshop training sections and applicability.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes4 repeat training-section assembly points minus0.5 upkeep=3.5. Low: a new device process needs fresh training content, leaving only1 stable general-handling section point removable, minus0.5=0.5. Actual assessment, adaptation/checking, supervision and observed records retain their time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reduce selected source and teaching-material preparation while retaining clinical and workshop judgement.
role.ambitious_version: Reliable supporting material for practitioners who retain fitting, fabrication and supervision responsibility.
